areas.label: Art
areas.description: Images made with AI, curiosity and a fair amount of wandering. Some are quiet, some are a little strange; most seem to be looking for tenderness, light, or somewhere good to sit.
areas.empty: Selected work and collections will appear here.

items.title: Small acts, whole worlds
items.summary: A cup of tea, a hand held, a door left open. The grand themes keep turning up in very small gestures.
items.alt: A close view of hands offering a warm cup over bread at a worn wooden table.

images.title: Something warm
images.alt: A woman offers a cup to a bearded man at a sunlit table, with a child nearby.
images.description: A sacred visit at an ordinary table. Someone still has to put the kettle on.

images.title: Staying
images.alt: A seated woman holds the hand of an older person resting beneath a blue quilt.
images.description: There may be very little to say. A hand can stay.

images.title: A stitch in the afternoon
images.alt: An older woman sews beside a bright window in a quiet room.
images.description: Light at the window, a little mending. An afternoon allowed to take its time.

images.title: The door is open
images.alt: A child plays on a tiled floor beside an open doorway leading into sunlight.
images.description: The room is small; the world outside is enormous. For now, the floor has plenty to offer.

images.title: One more note
images.alt: A person plays an upright piano in a spare room filled with soft afternoon light.
images.description: An ordinary room with enough space for music. You can almost hear the pause between notes.

images.title: The apple stays
images.alt: A fallen apple rests among autumn leaves on a sunlit woodland path.
images.description: An apple among fallen leaves, quietly joining the season. Even the beautiful things get to change.

images.title: A small bow
images.alt: A small child in red kneels beside flowers, incense and a gold-lit household shrine.
images.description: Flowers, incense, a small red figure. Reverence begins quite close to the ground.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: Some days, love looks like making someone a cup of tea and remembering the bread.

items.title: Mercy & unlikely company
items.summary: A little less judgement, a little more room at the table. Familiar sacred images, with a few unexpected guests.
items.alt: A robed figure sits with a dark-winged companion on steps overlooking a quiet landscape.

images.title: No need to hide
images.alt: A white-robed figure offers a hand to a seated dark-winged figure on stone steps.
images.description: An open hand on the steps. There is room here for the parts of us we would rather keep out of sight.

images.title: A place beside you
images.alt: A dark-winged figure sitting beside a robed figure who extends an open hand.
images.description: Two figures pause together, with no battle to settle. A strange, gentle possibility.

images.title: Close enough
images.alt: An icon-like painting of two adults and a child resting close together against gold.
images.description: Gold leaf, halos, and the familiar business of leaning on someone you love.

images.title: Held
images.alt: An icon-like family embrace, with a child nestled between two haloed adults.
images.description: A family embrace in the language of an icon. The warmth is very much of this world.

images.title: Room at the table
images.alt: An improbable company of people and creatures shares a long outdoor table at dusk.
images.description: An improbable supper, with company from several corners of the imagination. Pull up another chair.

images.title: Three around a flame
images.alt: Three veiled figures in teal, dark blue and lavender gather around a flame in a luminous forest.
images.description: Three figures, one small fire. Being together can look so simple from a distance.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: Christ sits beside the one we might least expect. Mercy has awkward seating arrangements.

items.title: Light, dreams & other detours
items.summary: Lotuses, borrowed sunlight, impossible tenderness. The imagination occasionally takes the scenic route.
items.alt: A luminous woman in white seated among lotus flowers by a lake at sunset.

images.title: Here, take my hand
images.alt: A woman beside a lake reaches towards the viewer, with mountains and sunset behind her.
images.description: An invitation from the edge of the lake. No grand explanation; just a hand reaching out.

images.title: A little light
images.alt: A woman in white emerges through soft golden light, flowers and pale painterly colour.
images.description: A figure almost dissolving into flowers and sunlight. Softness has its own way of filling a frame.

images.title: The whole world, for a moment
images.alt: A softly painted adult and child embrace amid warm pink, gold and violet brushwork.
images.description: An embrace, with the edges left soft. Everything else can wait a moment.

images.title: The forest got carried away
images.alt: Golden sunbeams fall through a lush forest onto a bright carpet of flowers.
images.description: The forest was given a little sunlight and decided to make an occasion of it.

images.title: After the noise
images.alt: An enormous mechanical hand and weathered figure resting in water beside a ruined city.
images.description: A weathered figure, an enormous hand, water among the ruins. The scale is strange; the tiredness feels familiar.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: White Tara among the lotuses: a gentle presence, with the whole evening around her.

items.title: Earlier wanderings
items.summary: Forest visitors, botanical excess and a tea ceremony with questionable gravity. Work from 2025 and 2026.
items.alt: A flowing robed figure holds a teacup below a floating teapot, surrounded by luminous winged creatures in a lush forest.
items.credit: 无为茶会 — 2026 (Claude + Midjourney + GPT + GPT Image 2.5)

images.title: Luminous
images.alt: A solitary seated figure glows warmly in a dark painterly space.
images.description: A small warmth in a large darkness. Enough to sit with for a while.

images.title: Holy Trinity Reimagined
images.alt: Three veiled figures gather around a radiant fire in a dark sacred setting.
images.description: An old sacred composition wanders into the forest. The three remain gathered around a shared warmth.

images.title: Take it easy dude, but take it
images.alt: A seated figure rests in a luminous forest clearing framed by towering trees.
images.credit: Take it easy dude, but take it, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: A clearing, a place to sit, and no obvious reason to hurry. The title still asks us to show up.

images.title: The primacy of being
images.alt: A white-robed figure stands in a moonlit, mist-filled forest.
images.credit: The primacy of being, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: A figure in the mist, simply there. The forest seems happy with that.

images.title: Strangefield
images.alt: A pastel surreal landscape of rolling fields beneath an expansive sky.
images.description: A landscape that nearly remembers the real world, then happily loses the thread.

images.title: Bloom
images.alt: A kimono-clad figure stands among monumental red spider lilies.
images.description: The flowers have outgrown the garden and possibly the gardener. A good day to be small.

images.title: Untitled
images.alt: A figure in purple stands within a neon floral dreamscape.
images.description: Purple, flowers, and a place that has not settled on an address. The title can wait too.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: Tea in the forest, with curious company and a teapot relieved of its usual duties. Everyone seems to be managing.
